verdict.rationale: YYLO's Ledger provides Git-native task records with status/history tracking (yylo-docs-19, yylo-docs-11), and merge/task flows use protected SHAs, worktrees, and expected-old ref protection which supports rollback-safe delivery (yylo-gh-4, yylo-gh-5). Skills are independently versioned (yylo-docs-26), and workflows can be saved as reusable YAML contracts (yylo-docs-4). However there is no explicit 'review' UI/diff for automations, no dedicated rollback command for a completed automation run, and no versioned history browsing/diffing of workflow definitions themselves. missing for 10: explicit automation-version diffing/review UI, a documented rollback command for completed runs, version history for workflow YAML changes over time.
